odoo.name: Late Transfers
odoo.predicate: state in assigned/waiting/confirmed and (has_deadline_issue or date_deadline < current_date or scheduled_date < current_date)

comparison: Core3 preserves the source action name, Late context, list/kanban/form/calendar intent, active-state predicate, search fields, operation filters, and transfer navigation. Core3 adds durable company queue context, refresh history, fixed seeded dates, and explicit permission/concurrency boundaries. Odoo deadline data is represented by durable date_deadline and has_deadline_issue fields; the Core3 visual comparison remains open because its shared runtime is blocked before serving.
